# Summary: A 2019 UK Political Manifesto

This manifesto outlines a comprehensive programme for government centred on addressing what it identifies as key challenges: climate change, economic inequality, and the state of public services.

## Economic and Environmental Policy

The document proposes a "Green Industrial Revolution" to tackle climate change while creating employment. Key commitments include achieving net-zero carbon emissions, investing £400 billion through a National Transformation Fund, and £250 billion specifically for green infrastructure. The plan involves massive expansion of renewable energy (wind, solar, and tidal power), upgrading 27 million homes for energy efficiency, and supporting a transition to electric vehicles.

The manifesto calls for nationalising rail, mail, water, and energy services. It proposes creating British Broadband to deliver free full-fibre internet nationwide. A National Investment Bank would provide £250 billion in lending over ten years, supported by regional development banks.

## Public Services

Healthcare plans include significant NHS funding increases, ending privatisation, abolishing prescription charges, and providing free dental check-ups. A National Care Service would deliver free personal care for older people.

Education proposals include a National Education Service offering free lifelong learning, abolishing university tuition fees, restoring maintenance grants, and expanding early years provision with 30 free hours weekly for 2-4 year olds.

## Workers' Rights and Social Security

The manifesto proposes a £10 minimum wage, banning zero-hours contracts, and establishing sectoral collective bargaining. It would require large companies to establish employee ownership funds giving workers stakes in their companies.

Social security reforms include scrapping Universal Credit, ending the benefit cap and two-child limit, and stopping welfare assessments deemed inhumane.

## Housing

Housing commitments include building over one million council and social homes within a decade, introducing rent controls, ending no-fault evictions, and eliminating rough sleeping within five years.

## Constitutional and Brexit Policy

The document proposes offering a referendum on any negotiated departure agreement from the European Union, with an option to remain. Constitutional reforms include reducing the voting age to 16 and eventually replacing the House of Lords with an elected Senate.
